description: Public attestation of a DID's trust level, signed by a Council-delegated attestor. Per ADR-2605260000, this record operationalizes the trust-level evaluation logic of the L5 authentication layer. Contains **no personal identifiers** — all PII is encrypted and stored separately in `credentialBinding.encryptedPayloadCid`. This record is safe to publish publicly; it only reveals trust level and temporal metadata. Emitted by the `gov_auth_trust_attestation` Pregel cell upon Council activation.

subjectDidHash.description: Blake2b-256 hash (base64url) of the subject DID. Used to correlate attestations without revealing the full DID to casual observers (privacy-preserving linkage). Verifiers with access to the subject DID can compute hash(did) and check equality.

trustLevel.description: Evaluated trust level. 1 = WebAuthn platform authenticator only. 2 = WebAuthn + MyNumber binding verified. Per ADR-2605260000, escalation from L1 to L2 requires opt-in MyNumber card binding + successful XChaCha20 decryption + IC chip validity check.

attestedBy.description: DID of the Council-delegated attestor who issued this attestation. Typically `did:web:etzhayyim.com:council:<seat>` or equivalent. Verifier should resolve this DID and validate the attestor's current delegation status.

reason.description: Reason code describing the trust pathway. 'webauthn-only' = FaceID/TouchID/Windows Hello platform authenticator verification only. 'webauthn-plus-mynumber' = WebAuthn + MyNumber IC chip read (via Web NFC). 'external-sso-bridge' = reserved for future R3+ OAuth/OpenID Connect bridge paths.

epoch.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this attestation was issued. Used to detect stale attestations and trigger re-verification.

expiresAt.description: Optional Unix timestamp (seconds) of attestation expiry. If omitted, attestation is valid indefinitely. If present, verifiers should reject attestations where `epoch > expiresAt`.

silenAuditCid.description: Optional IPFS CID of a `com.etzhayyim.gov.silenGovReview` audit record (per ADR-2605250100 pattern). If present, verifier can audit the Council's decision-making rationale.
